business_problem: CASETiFY needed to unify customer and commercial data because fragmented silos and limited scalability were slowing personalized experiences, collaboration, and decision-making across a fast-growing global brand.
solution_summary: CASETiFY uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support global personalization and marketing analytics. CASETiFY needed to unify customer and commercial data because fragmented silos and limited scalability were slowing personalized experiences, collaboration, and decision-making across a fast-growing global brand. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Serverless Workflows, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Serverless Workflows; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL.
